objective: Expand the internal tooling so coding agents can develop, tweak, debug and finish long-running Roag tasks using durable, current evidence.

requirements.description: Diagnose the checkout and conservatively identify relevant commands, docs and checks.
Reconnect to real verification processes, preserve logs, cancel safely and reject failed, stale or corrupted evidence.
Dry-run and apply validated content tweaks with conflict detection and no writes on failure.
Run deterministic declarative game scenarios with assertions, traces, save continuation and useful diagnostics.
Persist requirements and handoffs and prevent completion without fresh, intact evidence for the requested profiles; document and exercise the whole workflow.
